labs.pi_title: Director, Human Rights Program; J. Sinclair Armstrong Professor of International, Foreign, and Comparative Law
labs.research_summary: Supports human rights scholarship and practice at the law school through visiting fellows, student fellowships, events and publications.
labs.join_notes: The fellowships page describes Visiting Fellows (usually from outside the US, one semester to a year), Henigson and Satter postgraduate fellowships for Law School graduates, and summer and winter fellowships for law students. No contact person is named on the page.
